title: Finitely presented torsion-free modules over a valuation ring are finite free
statement: Let A be a valuation ring [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties] and M a finitely presented torsion-free A-module [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Then M is finite free over A.
